title: BZA Meeting December 1, 2026
text: Trustees Scott Donaldson, Chair sv Bator LIBERTY Fiscal Officer Townsh ip Rick Karr 7 7802 Liberty Road N. Fire Chief Powell, OH 43065 James P. Reardon 740.938.2000 LIBERTY TOWNSHIP BOARD OF ZONING APPEALS The Liberty Township Board of Zoning Appeals will meet at 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at the Liberty Township Hall located at 7802 Liberty Rd., Powell, OH 43065 to consider the following: Continued BZA #26-12 submitted by Anthony & Amanda Haislar for their property located at 791 Odevene Way, Delaware OH 43015 requesting an area variance to the Zoning Resolution, Article 7, Section 7.01.E to allow their emotional support duck(s) to remain on property. This .451-acre Planned Residence (PR) zoned property is located in Range 19, Township 4, Section 4, Liberty Township, Delaware County, Ohio. BZA #26-14 submitted by Ralph & Linda Williams for their property located at 8385 Steitz Rd., Powell OH 43065 requesting an area variance for a reduction in the side setback for an accessory structure. This 1.38-acre Rural Residence (RR-1) zoned property is located in Range 19, Township 3, Section 2, Liberty Township, Delaware County, Ohio. Approval of Minutes Other Business The above applications may be viewed on our website: www.libertytwp.org. on the bottom half of the home page under Liberty Township Calendar, click on Board of Zoning Appeals Meeting, Tuesday, December 1, 2026. The person responsible for giving notice of this public hearing by both publication and mail is Melissa Fernando, Liberty Township Zoning Secretary. www.libertytwp.org
